phrases.latin: In affluentiā vehiculāriā haerēmus; sērō adveniēmus.
phrases.english: We’re stuck in a traffic jam; we’ll be late.

phrases.latin: Vehicula viam obstruunt; prōgredī nōn possumus.
phrases.english: The cars are blocking the road; we can’t get on.
gloomy funerals struggle with heavy wagons

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 219, 394, 397.
